capabilities: View and embed Supernote .note files, including single pages, in vault notes
Export .note files as PNG, SVG, PDF, or Markdown and attach them to the vault
Import today's modified Supernote notes and text into the current note
Sync, download, and upload files via the device's Browse & Access feature
Customize OCR during Markdown conversion via companion plugins
extras: The OCR feature is marked beta. Beta builds are distributed via BRAT; screenshots and developer documentation live in separate files (SCREENSHOTS.md, DEVELOPER.md). The README notes known issues and a vector-ink setting as a fallback when rendered ink looks wrong.
motivation: The author uses a Supernote for handwritten notes and Obsidian for digital notes and wanted handwritten notes to flow directly from the device into the vault.
problem: Obsidian cannot display or import handwritten notes from a Supernote device, and getting them in usually requires a cloud service.

relations.evidence: Thank you to Tiemen Schuijbroek for developing the initial supernote Typescript library I forked.

requires.name: a Supernote device (Browse & Access over the network)

summary: Viewer, importer and exporter for Supernote .note files and Atelier drawings that syncs handwritten notes from the device into a vault.
